author: Karl Rock
description:
I was visiting the incredible Shah Jahan Mosque in Thatta, Pakistan, when this little girl stopped me and told me she makes vlogs too!

So I asked her to show me her channel… and what I saw was absolutely adorable. She’s out here making videos, hugging cows and documenting her life just like a real little vlogger!

We ended up making a vlog together, and this was honestly one of the sweetest moments of my trip through Pakistan. 🇵🇰

Go show this little vlogger some love and subscribe to her channel: EmaankiDuniya123.
title: I got stopped in Pakistan...
